notes.title: Karma Trad. Chinese Version Released
notes.notes:
Greetings,  


Due to various reasons Karma's released date has been held back till now,  
we sincerely apologize for the late arrival. 

Since Steam's review took longer than expected,  
our team decided to change our first launch to Itch. 

You can now purchase Karma from itch platform (Chinese Ver. only at the moment),  
we hope that this sad but hopeful story can slightly warm your weary hearts.    

Purchase via :
https://herstory.itch.io/karma


As promised, all of Karma's revenue (no matter whether you purchased the game on itch for $1.99 USD or more) [b]from 20th November 19  to 21st May 20 (include)[/b], will all be donated to Spark Alliance.   
We will be uploading the donation receipts on our official website, Facebook, Twitter and Patreon every month.   


If you specifically like to support our team's works you can do so via [url=https://buymeacoffee.com/herstory]Buy me a coffee[/url] or subscribe to our Patreon. 
( It's totally fine too if you're not interested<3 )    


As of Karma's English translation is still in the works,  
we will try our best to finish off English script translation within this month or before the end of December.  
The English version will be then release in a form of patch update.  
In the future, if funding allows,  we hope to also add Korean and Japanese version<3 (grin)    


Alright then,  have fun everyone!  
Remember to take a proper rest occasionally even you are in a hard time.
